summary: Labels and delimiters reduce ambiguity but remain soft controls unless authority and effects are enforced by the host.

points.text: A model can still follow malicious text inside a correctly labeled data block. Treat separation as a defense layer, not as proof that prompt injection is solved.
Aggressive sanitization can remove legitimate code, commands or quoted instructions that the task is meant to analyze; preserve the original artifact behind an auditable reference.
Trust labels become stale when derived content is copied into a new store or summary. Taint propagation and source-version checks add real implementation cost.
